title: An interpretable AF detector for 12-lead ECGs, compared head-to-head with deep learning and doctors
description: Code, results and registration evidence for an interpretable atrial fibrillation (AF) detector for 10 s 12-lead ECGs (logistic regression on named rhythm, P-wave and fibrillatory-activity features), tested against two deep networks and doctors. Each fresh-data test was committed and pushed before its data were opened and run once. The folder registration_evidence/ preserves the evidence outside GitHub: GitHub's server-side push log for the repository, the full commit log, and a git bundle of the history, with SHA-256 checksums; check_registrations.py re-checks the claims.
